descriptionChirho: A swarm of biting or stinging insects (traditionally identified as flies or a mixture of noxious insects), sent as the fourth plague upon Egypt (Exod 8:17-20[Heb 8:17-20], 8:25-27[Heb 8:25-27], Psa 78:45, 105:31). Multilingual evidence consistently renders as flies/insects: eng 'the swarm/swarms of flies,' spa 'la mezcla/moscas/enjambre,' hin 'makkhiyaan/makkhiyon,' arb 'dhubaab/dhubaaban,' kor 'pari-ga/pari tte,' swa 'mainzi.' The definite (with article) and indefinite forms both denote the same kind of insect swarm; the variation is purely grammatical.
